items.raw_excerpt: 19,000 West Bengal voters risk missing bypolls as Appellate Tribunals’ slow pace leaves 38 lakh appeals pending.
items.summary_en: About 19,000 voters in West Bengal may miss the bypolls. Slow work at appellate tribunals has left 38 lakh appeals pending. Many people are stuck waiting for their voter cases to be resolved.
items.summary_ko: 인도 서벵골에서 약 1만 9천 명의 유권자가 보궐선거에 참여하지 못할 위기에 놓였다. 항소심 재판부의 처리가 느려 380만 건의 항소가 밀려 있다. 많은 사람이 자신의 유권자 관련 사건이 해결되기를 기다리고 있다.
items.title_en: 19,000 West Bengal voters may miss bypolls
items.title_ko: 서벵골 유권자 1만 9천 명, 보궐선거 놓칠 위기
items.title_original: 19,000 West Bengal voters to miss bypolls as appeals remain pending in tribunals

items.raw_excerpt: The Vanuatu women's football team won the MSG Prime Minister's Cup title in Suva on Saturday, in honour of the victims of the MV Matui tragedy.
items.summary_en: The Vanuatu women's football team won the MSG Prime Minister's Cup in Suva on Saturday. They dedicated the title to the victims of the MV Matui sea tragedy.
items.summary_ko: 바누아투 여자 축구팀이 토요일 수바에서 열린 MSG 프라임 미니스터컵에서 우승했다. 이들은 이 우승을 MV 마투이 바다 참사 희생자들에게 바쳤다.
items.title_en: Vanuatu women win MSG Cup title in tribute to sea tragedy victims
items.title_ko: 바누아투 여자 축구팀, 바다 참사 희생자에게 바치는 우승
items.title_original: Vanuatu women win MSG Cup title in tribute to sea tragedy victims

items.raw_excerpt: The Évora trials resulted in average energy savings of between 16 percent and 20 percent and an estimated 15 percent reduction in greenhouse gas emissions.
items.summary_en: EDP has completed an energy project worth 18 million euros. Trials in Evora saved between 16 and 20 percent of energy on average. The project also cut greenhouse gas emissions by about 15 percent.
items.summary_ko: EDP가 1800만 유로 규모의 에너지 프로젝트를 완료했습니다. 에보라에서 진행된 시험에서 평균 16~20퍼센트의 에너지가 절약됐습니다. 이 프로젝트는 온실가스 배출도 약 15퍼센트 줄였습니다.
items.title_en: EDP finishes 18 million euro energy project
items.title_ko: EDP, 1800만 유로 에너지 프로젝트 마무리
items.title_original: EDP completes €18 million energy project

items.raw_excerpt: A zagueira do São Paulo, recém-campeão do Brasileirão feminino, entra no lugar de Thais Ferreira (Corinthians), cortada da equipe em razão de desconforto no joelho esquerdo. O Brasil faz o primeiro amistoso contra a Argentina no sábado (10), às 16h30, em Porto Alegre.
items.summary_en: Carol Gil, who just won the Brazilian women's league with São Paulo, has joined the national team. She replaces Thais Ferreira, who left with a left knee injury. Brazil plays Argentina in a friendly on Saturday in Porto Alegre.
items.summary_ko: 상파울루에서 브라질 여자 리그 우승을 차지한 캐롤 지우가 대표팀에 합류했다. 왼쪽 무릎 부상으로 빠진 타이스 페헤이라를 대신한다. 브라질은 토요일 포르투 알레그레에서 아르헨티나와 친선 경기를 치른다.
items.title_en: Brazilian league champion Carol Gil called up to national team

items.title_original: Campeã do Brasileirão, Carol Gil é convocada para amistosos da seleção

items.raw_excerpt: Department spokesperson Sello Maremane says operators should also avoid overloading their vehicles
items.summary_en: Gauteng authorities have warned scholar transport operators to follow safety laws. They are urged not to overload vehicles to protect students.

items.summary_en: Curitiba has opened sign-ups for a teacher selection process. In total, 1,443 jobs are on offer. Pay and deadlines are listed in the notice.

items.raw_excerpt: The Victorian region synonymous with boating, tourism and recreational camping is now home to a growing number of rough sleepers.
items.summary_en: Lakes Entrance in Victoria is known for boating and camping. Now more people are sleeping rough there. Local people and programs are trying to help them.

items.title_en: Town tries to help its growing number of rough sleepers

items.raw_excerpt: What would whiskey lovers have sipped in an independent Vermont 250 years ago? Village Garage Distillery's new barrel-strength malted rye aims to find out.
items.summary_en: A small distillery in Vermont has made a new barrel-strength malted rye. It tries to taste like whiskey from 250 years ago. The team wanted to know what local drinkers sipped back then.
items.summary_ko: 미국 버몬트의 작은 증류소가 새 배럴 강도 몰트 라이 위스키를 만들었다. 250년 전 이 지역 사람들이 마시던 위스키 맛을 재현하려는 시도다. 당시 무엇을 마셨는지 알아보고 싶었다고 한다.
items.title_en: Vermont Distillery Makes Rye Whiskey From 250 Years Ago

items.raw_excerpt: Yarmouth is a small town in Maine, about 20 minutes from campus. I worked with the Town’s Department of Economic Development to conduct research to create a Revolving Loan Fund for small local businesses, capitalize it, and establish a toolbox necessary to create one – a long-standing goal of theirs. I also undertook other projects related to municipal spending, legal research, and the town’s zoning ordinances.
items.summary_en: A college student spent a term working with the town of Yarmouth, Maine. He helped create a loan fund for small local businesses. He also worked on town spending, legal research, and zoning rules.
items.summary_ko: 한 대학생이 메인주 예러머스 마을에서 한 학기 동안 일했다. 그는 작은 동네 가게를 위한 대출 기금을 만드는 일을 도왔다. 또 마을 예산, 법률 조사, 구역 규정 업무도 맡았다.
items.title_en: Student helps small town build a loan fund for local shops

items.summary_en: The Caminhos do Dom project will be launched this Wednesday at 11 a.m. The event takes place at the Igreja das Fronteiras in the Boa Vista neighborhood.

items.raw_excerpt: Alvinho Lira (PP-AL) tem 20 anos e, em 17 de março de 2027, completará 21, a idade mínima para se tornar deputado federal.
items.summary_en: Alvinho Lira, the son of lawmaker Arthur Lira, has been elected as a federal deputy. He is 20 years old now and will turn 21, the minimum age for the job, on March 17, 2027. This makes him the youngest person ever elected to Brazil's federal congress.
items.summary_ko: 아르투르 리라 의원의 아들 알빈뉴 리라가 연방 하원의원에 당선됐다. 그는 현재 20살이며, 최소 자격 연령인 21살이 되는 2027년 3월 17일에 취임 요건을 갖춘다. 이로써 브라질 연방 의회 역사상 가장 어린 당선자가 됐다.
items.title_en: Son of Arthur Lira becomes the youngest federal deputy ever elected in Brazil
items.title_ko: 아르투르 리라의 아들, 브라질 최연소 연방 하원의원에 당선
items.title_original: Filho de Arthur Lira se torna o mais jovem deputado federal já eleito

items.raw_excerpt: Matthieu Blazy continued to loosen up Chanel’s house codes for spring/summer 2027, sending sheer skirts, tiger-print tweed and flashes of animal print down a spectacular Grand Palais runway.
items.summary_en: Chanel presented its spring/summer 2027 collection in Paris. Designer Matthieu Blazy used sheer skirts, tiger-print tweed, and animal prints. The show took place at the Grand Palais.

items.title_en: Chanel shows sheer skirts and wild prints in Paris

items.raw_excerpt: Funding for Te Papa, opening hours for galleries, the city's new years' eve fireworks display, and school swimming subsidies, are on the chopping block as Wellington City Council tries to meet rates caps.
items.summary_en: Wellington City Council needs to cut about $60 million. Money for Te Papa, gallery hours, New Year's Eve fireworks, and school swimming may be cut. Councillors call these 'nasty decisions' as they try to meet rates caps.
items.summary_ko: 웰링턴 시의회가 약 6000만 달러를 줄여야 하는 상황이다. 테 파파 지원금, 미술관 운영 시간, 새해 전야 불꽃놀이, 학교 수영 지원금 등이 삭감 대상에 올랐다. 시의원들은 요율 상한을 맞추기 위해 어려운 결정을 내려야 한다고 말했다.
items.title_en: Wellington council looks for $60m in savings
items.title_ko: 웰링턴 시의회, 6000만 달러 절감 방안 논의

items.summary_en: A national congress on pension law is being held in Curitiba. Public workers, managers and lawyers in the field will gather there. The local pension institute IPMC is supporting the event.

items.raw_excerpt: Japan's Ritsu Doan, center, celebrates with teammates after scoring his side's second goal during the Kirin Cup soccer final between Japan and New Zealand in Tokyo on Monday. Japan won 2-1.
items.summary_en: Japan beat New Zealand 2-1 in the Kirin Cup soccer final in Tokyo on Monday. Ritsu Doan scored Japan's second goal and the team celebrated together. The home crowd cheered the win.

items.raw_excerpt: A liveable city must remain liveable while it is being built, say Samuel Chng and Sarah Chan of Singapore University of Technology and Design.
items.summary_en: Big road work in Singapore is making daily travel hard for many commuters. Two experts say the city must stay nice to live in while it is being built. They ask if this tiredness can be managed better.

items.summary_en: Singer Luis Jara spoke out against cutting the budget for culture. He said art and music need public support. His words come as Chile debates its spending.

items.raw_excerpt: Domestic and international students turn a remote sheep station into a testing ground for their designs as they compete in the Australian Universities Rocket Competition.
items.summary_en: University students gathered at a remote sheep station in the Australian outback. They tested rockets they designed themselves. Teams from Australia and other countries took part in the Australian Universities Rocket Competition.

items.raw_excerpt: "Yo sería el más feliz si muero adentro de la cancha defendiendo a la U", expresó.
items.summary_en: Chilean football player Marcelo Diaz said he would be happiest to die on the field defending Universidad de Chile. He joked that he wants his ashes thrown at the club's stadium. Fans loved his deep loyalty to the team.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 축구 선수 마르셀로 디아스가 우니베르시다드 데 칠레를 지키다 경기장에서 죽는다면 가장 행복할 것이라고 말했다. 그는 자신의 유골을 구단 경기장에 뿌려 달라고 농담했다. 팬들은 팀에 대한 그의 깊은 충성심에 크게 반응했다.
